method: Status-augmentation proxy in front of the stub daemon: the proxy forwards every route to the daemon at http://127.0.0.1:65449, rewrites Origin to the daemon origin, and appends 150 synthetic MessageRow records to GET /v1/status for the selected thread. The app, its bundle, and the daemon are unmodified product code; only the fixture data is synthetic. Harness script lives outside the repo at /tmp/kat3240-status-augment-proxy.mjs.
note: Routine progress renders collapsed by default. The transcript is a bounded 800px scroll region inside the room, so a long transcript does not stretch the page. Arrow/Page keys did not scroll the transcript under the automation harness; Tab traversal of focusable transcript entries works and keeps focus visible. Pointer scrolling works.
